entities.summary: Carlos Arthur Sevilla is an American Catholic prelate who served as bishop of Yakima in Washington State from 1996 to 2011 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of San Francisco in California from 1988 to 1996. He is a member of the Jesuits. Carlos Arthur Sevilla was a religious figures from San Francisco (b. 1935-08-09, San Francisco).
